prediction.likelyOutcome: EQY should recover the large majority of its $170,484.37 rent claim against Williamson and Gore jointly, with the bench trial's real fight being how much of a credit, if any, Williamson gets for the free-rent overlap period and the abandoned personal property — both offset theories face real evidentiary gaps that should limit them to partial rather than full success. Attorney's fees are legally recoverable on top of this but are unquantified on this record.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the court awarded the landlord $170,484.37 in past-due rent, the full amount it sought, with no credit for the $62,096.52 free-rent overlap offset or the $20,000 personal property. It also awarded $86,725.00 in attorney's fees. On appeal the rent damages were affirmed and the fee award reversed.
outcome.finalNote: Rent damages affirmed; fee award reversed.
